title: ADA Compliant Grab Bar 63-Inch 3-Post Wall Mount Iron Pipe | Allied Brass
short_title: ADA Compliant Grab Bar 63-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add steady support to the bathroom with this ADA compliant grab bar featuring a three-post design for enhanced stability and a long 63-inch length. From the Pipeline collection, it brings an industrial pipe look that coordinates with transitional bathroom hardware while helping improve confidence and balance near the shower, tub, or toilet.

Highlights:
- 3-post grab bar design adds a third center bracket to help ensure stability
- ADA compliant grab bar for accessibility-focused bathroom spaces
- Wall-mount installation helps keep floor space clear
- Iron pipe construction with a highly durable powder coat finish
- Designer finish is built for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs:
- Overall length: 63 in
- Height: 3 in; Width/Projection: 3.58 in
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Product weight: 5 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Multiple designer finish options available

With superior materials that are free from corrosion and rust, this grab bar is a reliable and stylish addition to your bathroom.
